caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher with a wide body, a flared mouth, and a handle on the left side. The pitcher is rendered in shades of brown, with dark and light areas suggesting gloss and reflection on its glazed surface. The surface of the pitcher is decorated with raised patterns of corn stalks, including detailed depictions of corn ears and leaves. The background of the image is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the dark brown color of the pitcher. The handle appears to have a ridged texture. At the bottom left, the scale notation "2/3 INCH = 1 INCH" is written, and at the bottom right is the signature "W. H. Shurtliff '37".
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
